At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers 
A fantastic opportunity to lead product design within a squad to deliver world class products for our cabin crew
Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide   

Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.

Are you passionate about crafting great mobile experiences? As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll lead the design of mobile tools for our cabin crew, shaping strategy and delivering scalable, high-quality solutions that balance the needs of our people, the business, and the customer experience. If you’re ready to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

You'll be hands-on across the entire product journey—from discovering fresh ideas and digging into research, to shaping the experience and seeing your designs through to launch and ongoing improvement. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations and Service teams, making sure we deliver seamless, end-to-end experiences for our people and that your design vision stays front and centre from concept to delivery.

You'll set the standard for quality and act as a trusted advisor, guiding your teammates to lift their skills and ways of working. Part of your impact will be making the most of AI-enabled tools to boost insight, creativity, and efficiency—always keeping design judgement, accessibility and our brand in mind. If you love sharing your knowledge and raising the bar for design, we'd love to welcome you aboard!

We're keen to meet designers who are curious and hands-on with AI in their workflow. Strategic thinking to deliver innovative outcomes aligned with brief and brand.

Advanced logical reasoning and sound decision-making, including numerical
analysis.

Proven ability to solve high-impact design challenges in large, complex
organisations.
Expert facilitation skills, with a track record of successful outcomes.
Inspirational leadership for both direct and remote teams.
Clear communication of design concepts to stakeholders, adapting to the audience.
Extensive knowledge of current digital design standards and industry trends.

Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

The business (ABN 53 603 812 004) is a Darwin-based specialist HVAC hygiene company providing cleaning, inspection and maintenance services for commercial and industrial air conditioning systems, ductwork, commercial kitchen exhaust systems, cool rooms and mould-affected environments throughout the Northern Territory. Our clients include commercial, industrial, Defence and government organisations requiring specialist indoor air quality and HVAC hygiene services.  

We are looking for a reliable HVAC Cleaning Technician (High Access) to join our team.

About the Role
The HVAC Cleaning Technician (High Access) will carry out specialist cleaning, maintenance and inspection work on HVAC systems located in commercial, industrial and high-access environments. The role routinely involves safely accessing rooftop plant, elevated work areas and other difficult-to-reach locations using approved ladders, elevated work platforms and other approved height access equipment. 

The successful applicant will:
- Safely access rooftop plant, elevated mechanical services, ceiling spaces and other difficult-to-reach work areas using ladders, fall-arrest systems, elevated work platforms (EWPs), scissor lifts and other approved height access equipment to perform specialist HVAC cleaning, inspection and maintenance activities.
- Carry out specialised cleaning and hygiene services for commercial and industrial HVAC systems, ductwork and ventilation systems.
- Clean air handling units (AHUs), plant rooms, supply and return air ducts, evaporator coils, condenser units, filters and associated HVAC equipment.
- Perform commercial kitchen exhaust system cleaning, including hoods, ductwork, fans and associated ventilation equipment.
- Clean cool rooms, ventilation equipment and other specialist environments to maintain hygiene and operational standards.
- Assist with mould remediation and microbial cleaning projects in accordance with company procedures.
- Conduct pre-start inspections of elevated work areas, identify potential hazards and implement appropriate safety controls before commencing work. 
- Operate specialist cleaning equipment, including pressure cleaning equipment, HEPA vacuum systems and other industry-specific cleaning tools.
- Take photographs, complete digital job records, inspection reports and service documentation for completed works.
- Maintain company vehicles, tools, equipment and personal protective equipment in a safe and serviceable condition.
- Work professionally with clients, contractors and other team members while maintaining the company's high standards of workmanship and customer service.

Applicants should have:
- Experience in commercial HVAC cleaning, industrial cleaning, building maintenance, duct cleaning, ventilation system cleaning, or a similar hands-on trade or technical environment.
- Demonstrated ability and confidence to safely work at heights in commercial and industrial environments while complying with WHS requirements. 
- Experience using ladders, elevated work platforms (EWP), scissor lifts or other approved height access equipment will be highly regarded.
- Ability to operate pressure cleaning equipment, HEPA vacuum systems and other specialist cleaning equipment.
- Good physical fitness and the ability to perform manual work in commercial and industrial environments.
- Ability to read and follow work instructions, safe work procedures and site-specific requirements.
- Basic computer or mobile device skills to complete digital job records, inspection reports and photographic documentation.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a small team.
- A strong work ethic, attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship and customer service.
- Comfortable working on rooftops, elevated mechanical plant and other high-access locations as part of normal day-to-day duties. 

Applicants should have:
- Current Working at Heights certificate, or willingness to obtain prior to commencement
- Current driver licence.
- Current NT White Card or equivalent
- Elevated Work Platform licence or demonstrated experience operating EWP will be highly regarded
- Confined Space or First Aid training, or other relevant safety training preferred.

How to Apply
We are looking for motivated and reliable people who enjoy practical work and take pride in delivering high-quality HVAC hygiene, cleaning and maintenance services.  

To apply, please submit:

- How your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of this role.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a practical, professional team delivering specialist HVAC hygiene, duct cleaning, kitchen exhaust cleaning, mould remediation and commercial cleaning services across the Northern Territory, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in or telephone enquiries regarding this vacancy will not be accepted.

Little Corner BBQ is a contemporary Chinese restaurant located in Melbourne's CBD, specialising in authentic Chinese charcoal barbecue and regional Asian cuisine prepared using traditional cooking techniques and quality ingredients. The restaurant offers an extensive menu featuring premium meat, poultry, seafood, vegetable, and specialty barbecue dishes, complemented by freshly prepared side dishes and seasonal menu offerings.
Operating across lunch and dinner service, Little Corner BBQ is committed to delivering authentic flavours, consistent food quality, and exceptional customer service within a vibrant and fast-paced hospitality environment. The commercial kitchen focuses on fresh ingredient preparation, traditional Chinese barbecue cooking methods, quality control, efficient kitchen operations, and strict compliance with Australian food safety and workplace health and safety requirements.

This is a hands-on operational role responsible for preparing, cooking, and presenting authentic Chinese barbecue dishes and a diverse range of Asian-inspired cuisine in accordance with established recipes, quality standards, and service requirements. The successful candidate will contribute to all aspects of kitchen operations including food preparation, commercial cooking, stock control, quality assurance, and maintaining a safe and efficient commercial kitchen environment.
The role requires the ability to manage allocated kitchen sections, coordinate workflow during busy lunch and dinner service periods, maintain consistency in food quality and presentation, and work collaboratively with kitchen and front-of-house staff to ensure efficient service delivery and customer satisfaction.
This is a full-time permanent position based on a minimum 38-hour working week.

Food Preparation and Cooking
1.	Prepare, cook, and present a broad range of authentic Chinese barbecue dishes and Asian cuisine in accordance with established recipes and presentation standards.
2.	Prepare premium meat, poultry, seafood, vegetables, and other ingredients using appropriate preparation techniques including cutting, trimming, marinating, seasoning, skewering, and portioning.

4.	Assist with daily menu preparation, specialty barbecue items, and seasonal menu offerings.
5.	Maintain consistency in food quality, presentation, and portion control across all menu items.

Stock Control and Kitchen Organisation

2.	Apply FIFO stock rotation principles to minimise spoilage and maintain product freshness.
3.	Monitor ingredient usage and report stock shortages or purchasing requirements to management.
4.	Participate in stocktakes and maintain organised storage areas.
5.	Ensure appropriate labelling, storage, and handling of food products in accordance with food safety requirements.
Food Safety and Compliance
1.	Maintain compliance with Australian Food Safety Standards and safe food handling practices.
2.	Maintain high standards of hygiene and cleanliness throughout food preparation areas, equipment, utensils, and workstations.
3.	Monitor food storage, preparation, cooking, cooling, and holding temperatures to ensure compliance with food safety requirements.
4.	Follow workplace cleaning schedules, sanitation procedures, and operational policies.

5.	Sound knowledge of Australian Food Safety Standards, food hygiene, and safe food handling practices.
6.	Ability to work efficiently within a fast-paced commercial kitchen environment.
7.	Availability to work evenings, weekends, public holidays, and rostered shifts as required.

KEY COMPETENCIES

9.	Food safety and regulatory compliance.
10.	Commitment to continuous improvement and professional standards.

Please submit a one-page CV outlining your relevant qualifications, experience, and availability.
